AI 뉴스 · 논문 수집 (RSS · arXiv)

요약: Google News RSS 와 arXiv API 를 Express 에서 xml2js 로 파싱해 제공

구성

ReactAIPapers.jsx/api/ai-news→Express :5000RSS→Google NewsAI 트렌드 (한국어)
React/api/ai-papers→Express :5000Atom→arXivcs.AI 최신 20편

XML 응답을 xml2js 로 파싱해서 JSON 으로 돌려주고, 화면은 두 API 를 Promise.all 로 동시에 부릅니다.

경로처리

AI 뉴스 — Google News RSS

javascript
const axios = require('axios');
const xml2js = require('xml2js');

const getAINews = async (req, res) => {
	try {
		// Fetch AI trends news from Google News RSS (Korean)
		const response = await axios.get('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Artificial+Intelligence+Trends&hl=ko&gl=KR&ceid=KR:ko');

		xml2js.parseString(response.data, (err, result) => {
			if (err) {
				return res.status(500).json({ message: 'Error parsing XML', error: err });
			}

			const items = result.rss.channel[0].item || [];
			// Get top 5 items
			const news = items.slice(0, 5).map(item => ({
				title: item.title[0],
				link: item.link[0],
				pubDate: item.pubDate[0],
				// Google News description often contains HTML, we might need to strip it or just use it as is if we render html
				// For now, let's keep it simple. The description in RSS often has a snippet.
				description: item.description ? item.description[0].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '') : 'No description'
			}));

			res.json(news);
		});
	} catch (error) {
		console.error('Error fetching news:', error);
		res.status(500).json({ message: 'Error fetching news', error: error.message });
	}
};

module.exports = { getAINews };

AI 논문 — arXiv API

javascript
const axios = require('axios');
const xml2js = require('xml2js');

const getAIPapers = async (req, res) => {
	try {
		// Fetch 20 most recent AI papers
		const response = await axios.get('http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=cat:cs.AI&start=0&max_results=20&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending');

		xml2js.parseString(response.data, (err, result) => {
			if (err) {
				return res.status(500).json({ message: 'Error parsing XML', error: err });
			}

			const entries = result.feed.entry || [];
			const papers = entries.map(entry => ({
				id: entry.id[0],
				title: entry.title[0].replace(/\n/g, ' ').trim(),
				summary: entry.summary[0].replace(/\n/g, ' ').trim(),
				published: entry.published[0],
				updated: entry.updated[0],
				authors: entry.author ? entry.author.map(a => a.name[0]) : [],
				link: entry.id[0]
			}));

			res.json(papers);
		});
	} catch (error) {
		console.error('Error fetching papers:', error);
		res.status(500).json({ message: 'Error fetching papers', error: error.message });
	}
};

module.exports = { getAIPapers };

화면 쪽 호출

javascript
const fetchData = async () => {
    try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        // Parallel fetch for papers and news
        const [papersRes, newsRes] = await Promise.all([
            fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/ai-papers'),
            fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/ai-news')
        ]);

        if (!papersRes.ok || !newsRes.ok) {
            throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
        }

        const papersData = await papersRes.json();
        const newsData = await newsRes.json();

        setPapers(papersData);
        setNews(newsData);
        setLoading(false);
    } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to fetch data. Make sure the local backend is running (cd backend && npm start).');
        setLoading(false);
    }
};
